steps: For the guacamole, halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop out the flesh with a spoon. Squeeze the juice of the lime, finely chop the garlic, shallot, tomato, and chili.

Mash the avocado flesh with a fork and mix it with the yogurt, lime juice (caution! Start with only half, then season to taste to avoid making the guacamole too sour), shallots, tomato, chili, cumin, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with cilantro.
